_comment: Production rules for the forward-chaining inference engine. Each rule fires at most once (refraction). Conditions are tested against working memory; actions add or update facts.

eligibility_rules.name: CGPA to percentage
eligibility_rules.explain: Converted CGPA {cgpa} to {percentage:.1f}% using the standard formula (CGPA x 9.5).

eligibility_rules.name: Base cut-off
eligibility_rules.explain: The minimum required aggregate for {program_name} is {min_percentage}%.

eligibility_rules.name: Reservation relaxation
eligibility_rules.explain: A 5% relaxation applies for the {category_upper} category, so the cut-off becomes {required_percentage}%.

eligibility_rules.name: Qualification not accepted

then.value: your qualification ({qualification_label}) is not in the accepted list

eligibility_rules.explain: Your qualification ({qualification_label}) is NOT accepted for {program_name}.

eligibility_rules.name: Marks meet cut-off
eligibility_rules.explain: Your score {percentage:.1f}% meets the cut-off of {required_percentage}%.

eligibility_rules.name: Marks below cut-off

then.value: your score is below the cut-off

eligibility_rules.explain: Your score {percentage:.1f}% is BELOW the cut-off of {required_percentage}%.

eligibility_rules.name: Subject requirement met
eligibility_rules.explain: You studied the required subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics).

eligibility_rules.name: Subject requirement unknown
eligibility_rules.explain: Subjects were not mentioned, so I assume you studied Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in 12th.

eligibility_rules.name: Subject requirement not met

then.value: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics are compulsory in 12th

eligibility_rules.explain: B.Tech admission needs Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in 12th, which you did not mention.

eligibility_rules.name: No subject requirement
eligibility_rules.explain: There is no specific subject requirement for {program_name}.

eligibility_rules.name: Academically eligible
eligibility_rules.explain: Conclusion: you satisfy the academic eligibility for {program_name}.

eligibility_rules.name: Not eligible
eligibility_rules.explain: Conclusion: you are not eligible for {program_name}.

eligibility_rules.name: Entrance exam satisfied
eligibility_rules.explain: Your {exam_upper} score is accepted for admission.

eligibility_rules.name: Entrance exam pending
eligibility_rules.explain: You still need a valid entrance score ({entrance_list}).

eligibility_rules.name: GATE stipend
eligibility_rules.explain: Because you qualified GATE you are eligible for a stipend: {gate_stipend}.

scholarship_rules.name: Start with no waiver
scholarship_rules.explain: The tuition fee for {program_name} is {fee_per_year_rs} per year.

scholarship_rules.name: Merit tier 1 (>= 95%)
scholarship_rules.explain: Merit scholarship: {percentage:.1f}% >= 95% gives a 50% tuition waiver.

scholarship_rules.name: Merit tier 2 (90-94.9%)
scholarship_rules.explain: Merit scholarship: {percentage:.1f}% is in the 90-95% band, which gives a 30% waiver.

scholarship_rules.name: Merit tier 3 (85-89.9%)
scholarship_rules.explain: Merit scholarship: {percentage:.1f}% is in the 85-90% band, which gives a 15% waiver.

scholarship_rules.name: No merit scholarship
scholarship_rules.explain: {percentage:.1f}% is below 85%, so no merit waiver applies.

scholarship_rules.name: Sports quota
scholarship_rules.explain: Sports quota (state/national level) adds a 25% waiver.

scholarship_rules.name: Cap total waiver at 60%
scholarship_rules.explain: The total waiver is capped at 60%.
